description: This PHP class 'Zone' provides methods for retrieving and managing geographical zone data from a database within the OpenCart framework. It includes functions to get specific zone details, retrieve zones by country ID with caching, and count total zones per country.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: A model class in OpenCart for handling geographical zones, including fetching zone info, zones by country, and total zones count.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Fetches a specific zone record by zone ID, joining zone and description tables, filtering by language and active status.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves all zones associated with a specific country ID, utilizing caching for optimization.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the count of active zones associated with a specific country ID.
